dedupe_keys.name: agrovoc multilingual agricultural thesaurus linked open data

description: FAO's controlled vocabulary for agriculture, food and related fields. The AGROVOC home page says it is a Linked Open Data set of agricultural concepts, terms, definitions and relationships used to identify resources unambiguously, standardise indexing and link to other multilingual knowledge organisation systems, with online browsing and downloadable releases; in September 2026 FAO asked communities which African languages to add. The Bioregistry entry calls it the largest Linked Open Data set about agriculture and notes that the AGROVOC RDF download page states a CC BY 4.0 licence. Coverage is multilingual and global. Caveats: the licence is not shown prominently on the FAO site. For simulation it gives shared terms to tag and join agricultural datasets from different countries when building supply or impact models. A related catalogue record is the NIST grain supply chain traceability ontology.
